summary: Independent Physics Lab geometry audit: PR #303 exact head e09c617bac644a5a6a124ae8e22320d39fd59296 is patch-locally clean and has exact-head canonical CI PASS, but test-adversary PR #302 exact head c226479ee13f2bc0000822ce04df3a61aa42584f has a Reality-Grade reachability gap. Its ramp-entry invariant accepts the current low walkable surface at about 0.154 m above the floor because it only requires the lip to be <= the first stair top (0.18 m), so a substantial vertical step is normalized as a valid ramp entry. Audit verdict on #302 is REQUEST_CHANGES: define a small explicit floor-entry tolerance or deliberate transition geometry and make the authored recipe/test satisfy it. Roblox traversability/contact remains UNVERIFIED pending Studio evidence.
